title: Bulk Directed Landscape Convergence and Phase Transitions in Half-Space Models
summary: We study the effects of the boundary in the bulk of two half-space models. For half-space exponential last passage percolation (LPP) and the half-space log-gamma polymer, we establish convergence of their respective rescaled last passage time and free energy to the directed landscape when the observation window is at distance $f(n)n^{2/3}$ from the boundary and the attractive boundary strength is $o(f(n)n^{-1/3})$, where $f(n)\to\infty$ may diverge arbitrarily slowly.
